(Capacity: 17,341) |tourney=[[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = first round }} {{2021–22 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball team''' represented [[Marquette University]] during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team were led by first-year head coach [[Shaka Smart]] and played their home games at [[Fiserv Forum]] in [[Milwaukee|Milwaukee, Wisconsin]] as a member of the [[Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 19–13, 11–8 in Big East play to finish a tie for fifth place. As the No. 5 seed, they lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2022 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] to [[2021–22 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Creighton]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 9 seed in the East Region, where they lost in the First Round to [[2021–22 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]]. ==Previous season== The [[2020–21 Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball team|Golden Eagles]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 13–14, 8–11 in [[2020–21 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in ninth place. They lost in the first round of the [[2021 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] to [[2020–21 Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball team|Georgetown]].{{cite web|title=Marquette vs. Georgetown - Game Recap - March 10, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401308794|access-date=2021-04-07|website=ESPN.com|language=en}} On March 19, 2021, the school fired head coach Steve Wojciechowski.{{cite web|date=2021-03-19|title=Marquette fires Wojciechowski after 7 seasons|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/31094025/steve-wojciechowski-fired-seven-seasons-marquette-golden-eagles|access-date=2021-04-07|website=ESPN.com|language=en}} A week later, the school named [[Texas Longhorns men's basketball|Texas]] head coach [[Shaka Smart]] the team's new head coach.{{cite web|last=Mar 26|first=FOX Sports Wisconsin|last2=ET|first2=2021 at 11:59a|date=2021-03-26|title=Marquette hires Shaka Smart as new men’s basketball head coach|url=http://www.foxsports.com/wisconsin/story/marquette-golden-eagles-hires-shaka-smart-as-new-mens-basketball-head-coach-032621|access-date=2021-04-07|website=FOX Sports|language=en-US}} == Offseason == ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !
